postings.title: JM Millwrights Needed for Millstone Nuclear – Waterford, CT 9/29/26
postings.body:
Journeyman millwrights needed with nuclear experience. Red badged preferred

Dominion Millstone Nuclear Plant

314 Rope Ferry Rd. Waterford, CT

Contractor: GAWCO Great American Welding Company

In-Processing date: 9/29/26

4x10s for in processing

6x12s for outage starting 10/11/26 running until the end of October or Early November

Wage: $52.47

Health: $10.58

Pension: $11.46

Annuity: $6.50

**No per diem**

Please TEXT Evan Wytas 413-482-1530 your name and UBC #

    
 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 "In today’s environment, you have to continuously be improving. The UBC millwrights are the most highly qualified people that can be on a jobsite."

 
 Rick Rives, President, Atlantic Plant Maintenance

postings.title: Comanche Peak Nuclear Power Plant Scaffolders
postings.body:
Comanche Peak Nuclear Power Plant

Open call for Carpenters and Millwrights. This is a Scaffold assignment.

Need Scaffold Builders APP5 to JM 

Must Have Osha 10 Construction and Scaffold 40 quals

JM Hourly Wage of $36.47, Apprentices will receive their appropriate rates.

Fringe Benefits of $10.59

Please be advised, NO Per Diem. The work schedule will consist of six 12-hour shifts, with the project anticipated to be concluded on November 11. 

Great opportunity to get your Nuclear Red Badge.

Please Call Mayra Gutierrez 682-460-4060 or call 817-784-0429

Thank you,

    
 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 "In today’s environment, you have to continuously be improving. The UBC millwrights are the most highly qualified people that can be on a jobsite."

 
 Rick Rives, President, Atlantic Plant Maintenance
